## File: vllm-project_vllm/examples/online_serving/disaggregated_encoder/disagg_epd_proxy.py

Prompts

```
['build a python module to run a FastAPI proxy that routes chat completions through encoder, prefill, and decode clusters', 'run the disaggregated encoder proxy CLI with encode, prefill, and decode server URLs', 'test the /v1/chat/completions endpoint that routes multimodal requests through encoder and decode clusters', 'test the /health endpoint that checks the health of encoder, prefill, and decode clusters', 'run /start_profile and /stop_profile endpoints that fan-out profiling commands to all clusters']
```

Usage

```
{'build_disagg_proxy_server': 'build a python module to run a FastAPI proxy that routes chat completions through encoder, prefill, and decode clusters', 'run_proxy_cli': 'run the disaggregated encoder proxy CLI with encode, prefill, and decode server URLs', 'test_chat_completions': 'test the /v1/chat/completions endpoint that routes multimodal requests through encoder and decode clusters', 'test_health_check': 'test the /health endpoint that checks the health of encoder, prefill, and decode clusters', 'run_profiling_commands': 'run /start_profile and /stop_profile endpoints that fan-out profiling commands to all clusters'}
```
